set.body:
Implementation plan: docs/UI_FOUNDATION_PLAN.md, ticket G0.
Owner scope: eyes4s library infrastructure; the desktop app is a separate repository.

Intermediate acceptance gate added by the 2026-09-17 plan revision (docs/TRACKER_TRIAGE_2026-09-17.md, Tier 1). It proves the app vision first journey on the fixation-only route before recording and temporal payloads exist: fixation table in, cosine study out, save/reload/rerun, progress and cancellation.

Scope / proposed owned paths:
- tools/study-consumer/verify.py
- tools/study-consumer/build.sbt
- tools/study-consumer/src/ (bounded fixation-route consumer example)
- docs/UI_FOUNDATION_PLAN.md
- docs/SAVED_STUDIES.md
Inspect live state and reserve only exact files needed when implementation begins; these paths are not reservations.

Implementation:
- Extend the isolated packaged-artifact consumer with one scripted fixation journey: import a fixation CSV through the S2 input codec and source ledger, discover the cosine recipe through M1 descriptors, preflight it through M3, inspect the X1 pair schedule, run it through the X4 FS2 runner with progress and cancellation, and inspect source-linked results through M4.
- Archive the run through S4 result codecs and the S5 manifest/resolver; reload and rerun in a fresh process and compare complete values, keys, failures and denominators with the pure runner.
- Fixation inputs only: no RecordingPlan, TemporalStudyPlan, S3 payloads, X5 execution or X6 laws/budget measurement. Consumers supply explicit PairScheduleBudget values; PairScheduleBudget.default is effectively unbounded.
- Pin candidate/package versions and emit a receipt. No source-tree project dependency, package-private helpers or GUI runtime.

Proposed tests:
- Scripted happy path plus cancelled run, stale revision, failed-pair, missing/changed artifact and over-budget schedule paths; assert exact terminal outcomes and retained evidence.
- Pinned rational cosine and decimal Gaussian fixtures as numerical oracles; fresh-process identity reconstruction with exact keys, 64-bit times and semantic digests, named Tolerance for Gaussian values.
- Run compileAll/testAll/checkBoundaries and the consumer verify script on JVM and JS where the payloads are portable.

Acceptance:
A separate process can take a fixation table to a saved, reloaded and rerun cosine study through published eyes4s APIs with observable progress and cancellation, without recording or temporal support. Closing G0 does not close G1, X5, X6, S3 or S6.

Dependencies:
X4 (bd-01M2N2QBJ638R8GZAT5P2EWM33); S2 (bd-01M2N2QDV9JB6T6AYZG3D0TT3X); S4 (bd-01M2N2QEWQMWBSNRC30RQ5CCPP); S5 (bd-01M2N2QFF4NCTFZFDF87ZH3ERF); M4 (bd-01M2N2QJ1H158B984E0Z7YBTGK)

Cross-cutting requirements:
Pure modules stay effect-free and cross-compile JVM/JS; errors name operands; Agreement owns compatibility checks. Tests that claim type rejection use typeCheckErrors. Numerical checks use named Tolerance values; exact identities/digests are never compared approximately. No GUI, project storage engine, cloud service, new scientific-method breadth or full eyesim-parity claim.
set.title: UI-G0: Qualify the fixation-only route in the isolated headless consumer
